nsmbds-v0.4.5-alpha.description:
This update adds more customization for the emulator feed, two new traps, and an option to randomize the in-level secondary-screen backgrounds. It also includes several fixes for mislabeled locations, Secret Exit handling, and logic requirements.

### Added

* Added a fade-out effect to the emulator feed
* Added emulator feed settings to the client that apply immediately and are saved automatically:
  * On/Off
  * Width
  * Position
  * Fade-out duration
* Added the Power-Up Pickpocket Trap, which removes your stored reserve Power-Up
* Added the No Turnaround Trap, which temporarily prevents Mario from changing direction backwards
* Added an in-level secondary-screen background randomizer

### Fixed

* Fixed World 8-8 and World 8-Tower 2 being mislabeled
* Fixed World 7-6 and World 7-Castle being mislabeled
* Fixed the World 4-1 Secret Exit not being sent after completion when the Tower Key had not been received
* Fixed Secret Exit shortcuts being required for progression when secret_exit_shortcut_logic was disabled
* Fixed mixed-up requirements for the World 8 Toad Houses
* Removed the Large Mario requirement from World 3-1 Star Coin 3
